overview.title: Cloud administration
overview.description: Global operational metadata for this managed Caselog deployment.
overview.configurationDescription: These values are deployment-managed and read-only here. Change them through the production configuration and rollout workflow.
overview.securityDescription: This console exposes account and usage metadata only. Staff roles do not grant workspace membership, customer test data access, or hidden impersonation.

users.title: Users
users.description: Identity status and aggregate account relationships. Passwords and session secrets are never exposed.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.description: Tenant lifecycle and aggregate usage without customer test-management content.

billingAccounts.title: Billing accounts
billingAccounts.description: Commercial groupings above workspaces. Billing membership never grants workspace access.
billingAccounts.empty: No billing accounts match this search.

operators.title: Staff operators
operators.description: Grant short-lived operational access to an existing verified Caselog identity.
operators.grantDescription: Access expires automatically after at most 90 days. Every change requires a reason and is audited.
operators.listDescription: Revocation takes effect on the next request.

audit.title: Staff audit
audit.description: Append-only history of privileged operator lifecycle changes.
audit.empty: No staff audit events have been recorded.
